connector.name: Lotus - AI Citation Intelligence
connector.registryDescription: Measure how AI assistants cite your brand. Returns measured data and ready-to-apply fixes.
connector.summary: Hosted at lotus.clicon.app over streamable HTTP. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace app.clicon, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

headers.name: X-API-Key
headers.description: Client API key. Required for all tools except the anonymous preview mode of analyze_geo.
